name: 泰州华侨城云海湿地高尔夫球会 · Codex 18洞地图图层校准 v15
draft_note: All 18 holes use GolfLive-registered flag anchors and separate physical tee pads ordered by distance to the green. H1 uses a local fixed-landmark trace for its scope, fairway, route, and flag base instead of the drifting global silhouette. Published water, cart-path, tree and bridge layers are restored from a read-only local backend snapshot so the map-layer controls match the shared viewer; Codex scope, teebox, fairway, green, tees, flag and centreline remain independent. Partly occluded H14 tees and one H16 back tee are explicitly marked as inferred. Not surveyed; no shared database writes.
